release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.50 reworks Profiles into the same retailer -> named group -> profile hierarchy used by Tasks. The redundant Profiles title and subtitle are removed. Pokémon Center, Target, Walmart, and Amazon each expose their own expandable retailer branch with independently named profile groups, while existing unassigned profiles remain accessible through an Ungrouped Profiles lane. The hierarchy reuses Tachyon's existing Resource Organizer profile-group IDs so groups created in Profiles remain compatible with Tasks profile-group selectors. The existing validated profile editor is moved into a Tachyon modal with explicit group assignment while preserving edit, duplicate, archive/restore, import/export, validation, and non-payment identity storage behavior. Group creation, rename, delete, retailer isolation, profile assignment, and ungrouped recovery are covered by a dedicated real Chromium regression alongside the full browser suite and 120-task soak.
